facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/box_uti.compute_2d_box_iou: compute the 2D axis-aligned bounding box IoU between two boxes given as xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax tuples
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/box_uti.generate_3d_box_corners: generate 3D box corner coordinates from box size, heading angle, and center position
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/box_uti.clip_polygon: clip a subject polygon against a convex clip polygon using the Sutherland-Hodgman algorithm
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/box_uti.compute_convex_hull_intersection: compute the intersection polygon and area between two convex hulls given as lists of 2D vertices

facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/eval_de.run_eval_det_cls: run eval_det_cls to compute precision, recall, and average precision for a single object detection class
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/eval_de.run_eval_det: run eval_det to compute precision, recall, and average precision across multiple object detection classes
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/eval_de.run_eval_det_multiprocessing: run eval_det_multiprocessing to compute detection metrics across multiple classes using 10 parallel worker processes
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/eval_de.run_voc_ap: run voc_ap to compute VOC average precision from precision and recall arrays with optional 11-point metric
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/eval_de.run_get_iou: run get_iou or get_iou_obb to compute 3D bounding box IoU between two boxes

facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/metric_.calc_iou: compute the IoU of two axis-aligned 3D bounding boxes given their center and lengths
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/metric_.single_scene_precision_recall: compute true positives, false positives, and false negatives for predicted bounding boxes against ground truth
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/metric_.multi_scene_precision_recall: compute precision and recall across multiple scenes with optional label and prediction masks
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/metric_.precision_recall: calculate precision and recall metrics from true positive, false positive, and false negative counts
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/metric_.test_metric_util: run the built-in IoU and precision recall unit tests for the metric utility functions

facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nms.py.run_nms_2d: run 2D non-maximum suppression on axis-aligned bounding boxes with an overlap threshold
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nms.py.run_nms_2d_faster: run faster vectorized 2D non-maximum suppression on bounding boxes using IoU or overlap ratio
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nms.py.run_nms_3d_faster: run faster vectorized 3D non-maximum suppression on axis-aligned 3D bounding boxes
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nms.py.run_nms_3d_faster_samecls: run 3D non-maximum suppression that only suppresses boxes of the same class
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nms.py.run_nms_crnr_dist: run non-maximum suppression using bounding box corner distance measure instead of IoU

facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nn_dist.run_nn_distance: run nn_distance to compute nearest neighbor distances between two point cloud tensors
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nn_dist.run_huber_loss: run huber_loss to compute a smooth L1 loss on a PyTorch error tensor
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nn_dist.run_demo_nn_distance: run demo_nn_distance to print nearest neighbor distances for random point clouds
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nn_dist.test_nn_distance_l1smooth: test nn_distance with l1smooth=True to compute Huber loss-based nearest neighbor distances
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/nn_dist.test_nn_distance_l1: test nn_distance with l1=True to compute L1-based nearest neighbor distances between point clouds

facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/pc_util.random_sampling: randomly sample N points from a point cloud numpy array with optional replacement
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/pc_util.point_cloud_to_volume: convert an Nx3 point cloud into a 3D occupancy grid volume of given voxel size
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/pc_util.point_cloud_to_bbox: extract an axis-aligned bounding box center and dimensions from a point cloud
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/pc_util.write_ply_color: write colored point cloud data to a PLY file using class labels and a colormap
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/pc_util.rotate_point_cloud: rotate a point cloud around the Z axis by a random or given rotation matrix

facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/tf_logg.create_tensorboard_logger: create a Logger instance with a log directory for TensorBoard summary writing
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/tf_logg.log_scalar_summary: log a scalar variable with a tag, value, and step using Logger scalar_summary
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/tf_logg.log_image_summary: log a list of images with a tag and step using Logger image_summary
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/tf_logg.log_histogram_summary: log a histogram of tensor values with a tag and step using Logger histo_summary
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/tf_logg.review_logger_class: review the Logger class and its TensorBoard summary writer methods

facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/tf_visu.create_visualizer: create a Visualizer instance with an opt object and optional name for TensorBoard logging
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/tf_visu.log_images: log a dictionary of labeled images to the TensorBoard logger at a given step
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/tf_visu.log_scalars: log a dictionary of scalar labels and values to the TensorBoard logger at a given step
facebookresearch_imvotenet/utils/tf_visu.print_current_scalars: print and write epoch, iteration, and scalar values to the console and log file
